scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc .github packages workers infra
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc .github packages workers infra
scripts.test: if find packages workers infra -type f \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' -o -name '*.spec.ts' -o -name '*.spec.tsx' \) -print -quit | grep -q .; then bun test; else echo 'No tests have been added yet.'; fi && bun run --cwd packages/mobile test:native
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
